name: AI Addendum
description: Common Paper standard AI Addendum. Supplements an existing agreement with terms covering a provider's AI services, including use of customer input and output, model training restrictions, and related disclaimers.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Business Associate Agreement (BAA). Governs how a provider may use, disclose, and safeguard protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a customer under HIPAA.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Cloud Service Agreement (CSA). Standard terms for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products, covering access and use, payment, warranties, liability, and termination.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Design Partner Agreement. Gives a partner early access to a product in exchange for feedback and participation in the provider's design partner program.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Data Processing Agreement (DPA). Sets out how a provider processes customer personal data as a processor or subprocessor, including security, subprocessors, and cross-border transfers.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Common Paper Mutual NDA Standard Terms. Allows each party to disclose confidential information to the other for a defined purpose, with obligations on use, protection, and return of that information.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement Cover Page
description: Cover Page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA. Captures the deal-specific terms (purpose, effective date, MNDA term, term of confidentiality, governing law, jurisdiction, and signatures) and incorporates the Mutual NDA Standard Terms by reference.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Partnership Agreement. Standard terms for a business partnership between two companies, covering each party's obligations, payment, trademark licensing, confidentiality, and liability.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Pilot Agreement. A short-term contract that lets a prospective customer evaluate a product or service before committing to a full commercial agreement.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Professional Services Agreement (PSA). Standard terms for a provider delivering professional services under statements of work (SOWs), covering deliverables, payment, intellectual property, and liability.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Service Level Agreement (SLA). Designed for use with the Cloud Service Agreement; defines target uptime, response times, and service credits for a cloud service.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Software License Agreement. Standard terms for licensing software that the customer installs and runs on its own systems, covering the license grant, payment, warranties, and liability.
